subject: Welcome to TouristQR — {{businessName}}
html:
Hello {{contactFirstName}},

{{businessName}} is now listed on TouristQR as a {{kindWord}}.

Your public page — tap the QR code or open this link:
{{publicUrl}}

Sign in to add photographs, edit the wording, and keep the listing up to date:
{{adminUrl}}
Login name: {{username}}
Login password: {{password}}
You can change the password after you sign in.

Sponsorship started {{subscribedAtFormatted}}. The listing stays on the public site until {{publicUntilFormatted}}, then has one extra grace month (until {{graceUntilFormatted}}) before it is archived.{{extraMonthsSuffix}}

Your backups
You are responsible for keeping your own backup copy of your listing data and photographs. TouristQR does not store off-site backups for you.
After you sign in, open your sponsor profile, use Download my data, and save the JSON file somewhere safe (your computer, USB drive, or cloud storage). That file includes your profile, listings, photographs, and club logo when you have one. Use Restore my data only if you need to put a saved copy back on the website.

Referral offer: for every new business that names you when they sign up, you receive 1 extra month of public listing. They can give us your code {{genericLabel}} or your login name {{username}}.

TouristQR
